headline: Clowns, archangels and fake heads: Nairobi’s anime convention – in pictures
context: Organised by Movie Jabber, the annual Otamatsuri comic-con festival sees people dressed in costumes and accessories gather at Carnivore Grounds in Kenya’s capital to celebrate creative arts, gaming tournaments and comic book culture • This subheading was amended on 25 August 2026

sources.name: The Guardian
